description_target.target_text: Fixed borders + aligned inner mapping (top-align if no bottom border, proportional otherwise)

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; TEMPLATE objects (bbox holds another color) show how each color's
 ;; block is decorated. Every PLAIN block copies its color's template
 ;; interior (largest template per color wins): sides where the template
 ;; border is missing align to that edge, bordered axes scale
 ;; proportionally. A plain block whose color has NO template instead
 ;; takes a symmetric striped row pattern (first=last=its color) with
 ;; the middle run stretched to the block's width.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define objs (objects g 0))
     (define (has-inner? o)
       (not (all? (lambda (p)
                    (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                      (or (= v 0) (= v (obj-color o)))))
                  (positions-in-rect (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o)
                                     (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o)))))
     (define plains (filter (lambda (o) (not (has-inner? o))) objs))
     (define tmpls  ;; one template per color, largest first
       (let loop ((rem (sort-by (filter has-inner? objs)
                                (lambda (o) (- (obj-size o)))))
                  (seen (list)) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((empty? rem) (reverse acc))
               ((member? (obj-color (first rem)) seen)
                (loop (rest rem) seen acc))
               (else (loop (rest rem)
                           (cons (obj-color (first rem)) seen)
                           (cons (first rem) acc))))))
     (define tmpl-colors (map obj-color tmpls))
     (define (runs vals)  ;; run-length encode: ((value count) ...)
       (if (empty? vals)
           (list)
           (let loop ((rem (rest vals)) (cur (first vals)) (n 1)
                      (acc (list)))
             (cond ((empty? rem) (reverse (cons (list cur n) acc)))
                   ((= (first rem) cur) (loop (rest rem) cur (+ n 1) acc))
                   (else (loop (rest rem) (first rem) 1
                               (cons (list cur n) acc)))))))
     (define stripes  ;; rows: solid nonzero span, symmetric, >=3 odd runs
       (filter values
               (for/list ((r (range 0 h)))
                 (let ((cs (filter (lambda (c) (> (at g r c) 0))
                                   (range 0 w))))
                   (if (empty? cs)
                       #f
                       (let ((vals (for/list ((c (range (min-list cs)
                                                        (+ (max-list cs) 1))))
                                     (at g r c))))
                         (if (and (all? (lambda (v) (> v 0)) vals)
                                  (> (length (remove-duplicates vals)) 1)
                                  (= (first vals) (last vals))
                                  (odd? (length (runs vals)))
                                  (>= (length (runs vals)) 3))
                             vals
                             #f)))))))
     (define (fit-center-run vals target-w)
       ;; same runs, middle run stretched so the total width = target-w
       (let* ((rs (runs vals)) (n (length rs)) (mid (quotient n 2))
              (mid-len (- target-w
                          (for/sum ((i (range 0 n))
                                    #:when (not (= i mid)))
                            (second (nth rs i))))))
         (if (< mid-len 1)
             #f
             (apply append
                    (for/list ((i (range 0 n)))
                      (make-list (if (= i mid) mid-len (second (nth rs i)))
                                 (first (nth rs i))))))))
     (define (depth limit full-at?)  ;; solid border thickness from an edge
       (let loop ((d 0))
         (if (and (< d limit) (full-at? d)) (loop (+ d 1)) d)))
     (define (dress out tmpl)
       (let* ((pc (obj-color tmpl))
              (tr1 (obj-r1 tmpl)) (tc1 (obj-c1 tmpl))
              (tr2 (obj-r2 tmpl)) (tc2 (obj-c2 tmpl))
              (row-full (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) pc))
                                          (range tc1 (+ tc2 1)))))
              (col-full (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) pc))
                                          (range tr1 (+ tr2 1)))))
              (top-b (depth (obj-h tmpl) (lambda (d) (row-full (+ tr1 d)))))
              (bot-b (depth (obj-h tmpl) (lambda (d) (row-full (- tr2 d)))))
              (left-b (depth (obj-w tmpl) (lambda (d) (col-full (+ tc1 d)))))
              (right-b (depth (obj-w tmpl) (lambda (d) (col-full (- tc2 d)))))
              (ti-r1 (+ tr1 top-b)) (ti-r2 (- tr2 bot-b))
              (ti-c1 (+ tc1 left-b)) (ti-c2 (- tc2 right-b))
              (ti-h (+ 1 (- ti-r2 ti-r1))) (ti-w (+ 1 (- ti-c2 ti-c1)))
              (scale (lambda (i span-in span-out)
                       (min (inexact->exact
                             (round (* (/ (+ 0.0 i)
                                          (+ 0.0 (max 1 span-in)))
                                       span-out)))
                            span-out))))
         (for/fold ((acc out))
                   ((plain (in-list (filter (lambda (p)
                                              (= (obj-color p) pc))
                                            plains))))
           (let* ((pi-r1 (+ (obj-r1 plain) top-b))
                  (pi-r2 (- (obj-r2 plain) bot-b))
                  (pi-c1 (+ (obj-c1 plain) left-b))
                  (pi-c2 (- (obj-c2 plain) right-b))
                  (pi-h (+ 1 (- pi-r2 pi-r1)))
                  (pi-w (+ 1 (- pi-c2 pi-c1))))
             (if (and (> ti-h 0) (> ti-w 0) (> pi-h 0) (> pi-w 0))
                 (for*/fold ((a acc)) ((r (range pi-r1 (+ pi-r2 1)))
                                       (c (range pi-c1 (+ pi-c2 1))))
                   (let* ((sr (cond ((zero? bot-b)
                                     (min (+ ti-r1 (- r pi-r1)) ti-r2))
                                    ((zero? top-b)
                                     (max ti-r1 (- ti-r2 (- pi-r2 r))))
                                    (else (+ ti-r1 (scale (- r pi-r1)
                                                          (- pi-h 1)
                                                          (- ti-h 1))))))
                          (sc (cond ((zero? right-b)
                                     (min (+ ti-c1 (- c pi-c1)) ti-c2))
                                    ((zero? left-b)
                                     (max ti-c1 (- ti-c2 (- pi-c2 c))))
                                    (else (+ ti-c1 (scale (- c pi-c1)
                                                          (- pi-w 1)
                                                          (- ti-w 1))))))
                          (lc (at g sr sc)))
                     (if (and (> lc 0) (not (= lc pc)))
                         (set-cell a r c lc)
                         a)))
                 acc)))))
     (define (stripe out plain)
       (let ((pc (obj-color plain)) (pw (obj-w plain)))
         (if (member? pc tmpl-colors)
             out
             (let ((fitted
                    (find-first (lambda (x) x)
                                (map (lambda (vals)
                                       (if (and (= (first vals) pc)
                                                (= (last vals) pc))
                                           (fit-center-run vals pw)
                                           #f))
                                     stripes))))
               (if fitted
                   (for*/fold ((a out))
                              ((r (range (obj-r1 plain)
                                         (+ (obj-r2 plain) 1)))
                               (i (range 0 pw)))
                     (set-cell a r (+ (obj-c1 plain) i) (nth fitted i)))
                   out)))))
     (for/fold ((out (for/fold ((o g)) ((t (in-list tmpls))) (dress o t))))
               ((p (in-list plains)))
       (stripe out p)))))
